description:
About the Role:  

 Build reliable, client-facing technology that supports mission-critical business processes and decisions at Baird. As an experienced .NET Software Developer, you’ll update and modernize applications while partnering closely with technology teams and the business to deliver meaningful results 

 At Baird, software development is a craft. You’ll collaborate with a strong developer community in an Agile/Lean environment, applying modern tools, proven engineering practices and continuous learning to build high-quality, maintainable solutions 

 You’ll join a DevOps culture where IT is a valued business partner and developers are empowered to improve applications, strengthen delivery practices and contribute to the continued growth of our development capabilities.  

 This position offers a hybrid working arrangement based in our Madison office, with at least 3 days per week in the office and the remaining time remote. This schedule supports relationship building and consensus across leaders and teams. 

 Baird is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status.  

 Note to External Recruiters / Search Firms: Baird does not accept unsolicited resumes and will not compensate for any placement resulting from such submissions. Any unsolicited resumes received will not be treated as valid applications.  

 The Impact You’ll Make:  

 Systems Analysis, Development & Solution Delivery: 
 Refactor and enhance readable, testable, extensible and maintainable software with limited guidance 
 Apply software development principles and best practices, including SOLID, DRY and single-responsibility principles, based on the needs of each solution 
 Diagnose and resolve application issues, create thorough development tests and write unit and component tests while identifying opportunities to improve functionality, reliability and maintainability 
 Use SQL and database concepts to support solutions, translate tactical business needs into technical approaches and implement changes through Baird’s release management process 
 Identify and help manage risks, issues, dependencies and milestones while applying craftsmanship practices such as pairing and unit testing 
 
 Relationship & Stakeholder Management: 
 Build collaborative relationships across IT and work effectively with internal clients, business analysts, project managers and developers 
 Navigate organizational dynamics with guidance to support informed decisions and successful outcomes 
 Manage stakeholder expectations for medium-sized initiatives and tailor messages and communication styles to the audience 
 
 Team Collaboration & Development: 
 Contribute to refinement sessions by helping create clear, well-written and consistently sized user stories and applying Baird Delivery Fundamentals 
 Help implement lifecycle management best practices, support continuous team improvement and mentor development interns as opportunities arise 
 
 Engineering Excellence & Innovation: 
 Actively contribute to continuous improvement activities that strengthen software development practices 
 Support the growth of Baird’s development capabilities through internal and external initiatives, including Deming, cross-team projects and Milwaukee SPIN 
 Contribute to strategic initiatives, architectural patterns and best practices, including release management, application-layer security and Azure, while exploring practical uses for new technologies 
 
 What You’ll Bring to Baird:  

 Minimum of 3 years of demonstrated experience developing solutions across multiple tiers using the Microsoft technology stack, including object-oriented design, C#, MVC, ASP.NET and Web API 
 Competence working with SQL Server and other database technologies 
 Creative problem-solving skills with an automation-focused mindset and experience reducing recurring work or enabling user self-service 
 Passion for software development and experience supporting modernization of applications 
 Experience collaborating with internal clients, business analysts, project managers and developers to gather requirements and successfully deliver software solutions 
 A quality-focused approach with an interest in incremental delivery, continuous learning and process improvement 
 A collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively within and across teams in an Agile/Lean development environment 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with technical and business stakeholders 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Software Engineering preferred, or equivalent experience 
 
 Compensation and Benefits:  

 Compensation and bonus are commensurate with experience, performance and/or firm profitability 
 You’ll have the opportunity to advance your career while enjoying our comprehensive benefits designed for your life, career and future.
